label: OptiXtrans E6616 OTN platform, DC chassis, 14x B1LDCD (56x 100GE client, 28x 200G line)
description: Huawei OptiXtrans E6616 - 5U OTN transport platform, 2.8 Tbit/s with the TMK5SXCH or TMK6XCH cross-connect (2.4 Tbit/s with TMK5XCH, 920 Gbit/s with the unified TMK5UXCME), 14 service slots in the DC chassis (12 under 1500 W AC power, 10 under 2400 W AC power), 200 Gbit/s ODUk per service slot. Modelled fully populated with 14x B1LDCD muxponder boards: 56x 100GE client ports and 28x 200G line ports.
notes:
Port list is a stated card complement, not a fixed chassis figure: the E6616 is a 5U shelf with 14 service slots in its DC chassis (12 or 10 under AC power, see below), so 56 client + 28 line is what "14x B1LDCD" means. Fewer boards, or the OTN/SDH switch boards (K5XCH 2.4T OTN, K5SXCH OTN+SDH) in place of a muxponder, give a different box - the same convention as devices/arista/7504r.json.

Per board, B1LDCD is 4x 100GE client (QSFP28, LR4/SR4/CLR4 or OTU4) into 2x programmable 100G/200G line (CFP2). The line side is a CFP2 cage and takes CFP2 optics only: a 200G QSFP56 module carries the same rate and will not seat, which the link validator refuses by name (E_CONNECTOR_MISMATCH) rather than accepting and quietly running at the wrong rate. Switching a board to its 100G line mode halves the line rate and lets 4x OTU4 map to 2x OTU4.

Not a packet switch: client ports carry OTU4/100GE into OTN containers, and there is no L2/L3 forwarding, which is why capabilities is cli only - same reading as the Cisco NCS 1004. FEC, PRBS, ALS, 1588v2, G.8275.1 and AES-256 client encryption are board features and are not modelled as port capabilities. The board census (TMB1LDCD = 4x 100G client into 2x 100G/200G line) is not in the cited E6616 datasheet: its text layer has no board part numbers, and the document that states the front panel is Huawei's boards-overview chapter EDOC1100156575BEJ09044, which sits behind the support wall (302 to the login gate for every user-agent, research/optixtrans-e6600-xt-census.md section 5). The complement in the label is therefore a build recorded here, not a claim the cited PDF carries - a spec that quotes a source it did not read is the error this project has corrected most often.

Power configuration is part of this census, not a footnote: the build above is the DC chassis (assembly chassis TMK5K31AFB), whose service slots are 1-14. The AC chassis has fewer - service slots 2, 4 and 5-14, printed as 12/10 - because the APIU boards take power slots: a 1500 W AC chassis (TMK5K33AFB, dual power supply modules, APIU in slots 1 and 3) gives 12 service slots, and a 2400 W AC chassis (TMK5K35AFB, four power supply modules, APIU in slots 1-4) gives 10. The same 14x B1LDCD build would therefore overstate an AC shelf by 2 boards (8 client ports) or 4 boards (16 client ports). Source: chapter 1 (E6616 Chassis), Tables 1-2, in the cited document - OptiXtrans E6600 V100R025C10 Product Documentation, 20 pp, read 2026-11-18 at https://e-file.huawei.com/marketingcloud/pep/asset/20000001/Material/621bfc22e8564cf69ae86581569a7594/M3T1A669N1304588489052958777/_2_-OptiXtrans%20E6616-Datasheet.pdf The V100R026C00 (26H2) brochure prints 400 Gbit/s as the \"maximum single-channel rate\" and in the line-rate list, where the V100R025C10 chassis chapter caps an ODUk slot at 200 Gbit/s: one is a line-side figure and the other a per-slot capacity, so they are recorded side by side in research/optixtrans-e6616-brochure-26h2.md rather than merged into a single claim.

fabric.note: 2.8 Tbit/s OTN cross-connect for the 14-slot shelf with the TMK5SXCH switch board, which carries SDH as well (140 Gbit/s VC-4, 20 Gbit/s VC-3/VC-12); TMK6XCH gives the same 2.8 Tbit/s OTN with no SDH, and TMK5XCH is 2.4 Tbit/s OTN only. Verbatim from OptiXtrans E6600 Product Documentation chapter 1 (E6616 Chassis), Table 1 "Current subrack capacity": TMK5SXCH 200 Gbit/s ODUk per slot into 2.8 Tbit/s subrack, TMK5XCH 200 Gbit/s into 2.4 Tbit/s, TMK6XCH 200 Gbit/s into 2.8 Tbit/s. Line ports are excluded from the offered figure: each one is the far end of a client connection the fabric already carries once. The V100R026C00 (26H2) brochure adds a fourth, unified switch option that the chapter does not list: TMK5UXCME, 920 Gbit/s of OTN cross-connect, 920 Gbit/s of OSU and 920 Gbit/s of packet switching, with 160 Gbit/s VC-4 / 20 Gbit/s VC-3/VC-12 SDH - so a shelf built with it is a ~0.9 Tbit/s box, not a 2.4-2.8 Tbit/s one. The capacityMbps above stays at 2,800,000 because it follows the K5SXCH-class build the label describes, not the best board in the family. Source: OptiXtrans E6616 V100R026C00 Product Brochure (26H2), 515,695 B, read 2026-11-18, https://e-file.huawei.com/marketingcloud/pep/asset/20000001/Material/dc67ba7b606b46df975107406dafb0a1/M3T1A590N1296416246227165363/OptiXtrans%20E6616%20V100R026C00%20Product%20Brochure.docx
